references.text: Kedesh is mentioned as one of the cities given to the tribe of Naphtali, the same city over which the king of Kedesh ruled.
Kedesh in Galilee was designated as a city of refuge and a Levitical city, highlighting its significance in Israel's history.
Jokneam is mentioned in connection with Zebulun's border, the same city whose king was defeated.
Jokneam was given to the Merarite Levites as a Levitical city.
Carmel is mentioned as a place where Elijah confronted the prophets of Baal, a mountain near Jokneam by Carmel.
Kedesh is mentioned as one of the camping sites during Israel's journey in the wilderness.
